## Scope and linked Issue

Closes #

### What changed

Explain which files, DB IDs or behavior changed, and whether any vanilla entry is intentionally overridden.

### Evidence (no promotion across levels)

- [ ] L1: unit or negative tests — command, SHA, outcome (or N/A with reason)
- [ ] L2: XML/asset/source contracts — exact validator, outcome (or N/A)
- [ ] L3: real target framework and genuine game assembly build — build job, hashes (or NOT RUN)
- [ ] L4: actual game workflow — game version, DLC/mods, save type, steps, screenshots/logs (or NOT RUN)
- [ ] Regression: baseline labs/CBC, save/load and declared supported DLCs (or NOT RUN)

### Compatibility, risks and rollback

List exact overridden IDs, known incompatibilities and how to remove the change. No game binaries in commits or public build artifacts.

### Acceptance and stop rule

Identify the Issue's pass/fail criteria. Do not describe source-only or CI-only success as a gameplay pass.
